name: 木垒县智算中心项目 (Mulei County Smart Computing Center, phases 1-4)
notes: Two Mulei county smart-computing-center projects (bidding stages 1-4, design+construction EPC) reported Sep 2025; planned to be operational by end Sep 2025. Capacity/MW not disclosed in source; part of Xinjiang's growing compute buildout.

name: 中国移动—阿里云智算中心 (China Mobile-Alibaba Cloud Smart Computing Center, Yiwu County)
notes: Located in Yiwu County computing-innovation demonstration zone; 12,000P compute fully operational per Hami gov site (Jul 2025); phase-1 designed for 100k+ GPU cards; first batch of the Chongqing(Xinjiang) computing base ('疆算入渝' program).

name: 哈密伊吾县先进计算集群二期 (Yiwu County Advanced Computing Cluster Phase 2)
notes: Total planned compute of 60,000P across the county; Phase 2 fully topped out (Nov 2024). Unverified aggregate; part of Hami's rapid 智算 expansion.

name: 伊吾县智算中心项目 (Yiwu County Smart Computing Center)
developer: Zhongbei Communication (中贝通信) as EPC
notes: Zhongbei won the 357M RMB software/hardware integration contract (Feb 2025); IDC rooms and smart-compute cluster reported connected; also part of 20亿 RMB investment-intent cooperation with Jinkai New Energy.

name: 新疆喀什绿色节能智算中心 (Kashi Green Energy-Saving Smart Computing Center)
notes: Signing-ceremony announcement: planned investment >2B RMB, ~5,000P compute. Signing-stage only; treat as intent until construction evidence appears.

name: 克拉玛依云计算产业园 (Karamay Cloud Computing Industrial Park)
developer: Karamay cloud park (Huawei Cloud Service DC, China Mobile Xinjiang-Karamay smart compute center, CNPC data center, Silk Road New Cloud green compute center, carbon+water-cooled DC)
notes: Six data-center clusters built; 6 smart-compute centers providing >20,000 PFLOPS (Apr 2026); ~17,000P compute scale, first Xinjiang city past 10,000P (Jun 2025).

name: 克拉玛依30万千瓦光伏算电协同一体化项目 (300MW PV + Computing Integration Project)
notes: PV-storage + smart-compute integrated project entered trial operation (Jan 2026); green power directly supplies the compute center.

name: 新疆克融云算数字科技智算中心 (Kelong Cloud Compute Smart Computing Center)
developer: Aorede (奥瑞德) + Karamay Cloud Investment JV
notes: JV (Xinjiang Kerong Cloud Computing Digital Tech) formed to build smart-compute capacity; early-stage disclosure only.

name: 塔城智算产业托里集聚区万P万卡项目 (Tacheng Smart-Computing Toli Cluster, 10kP/10k-card)
notes: Launch ceremony Dec 29, 2025; 22 registered enterprises, total investment >23B RMB including LLM training factories, digital-economy park and smart-compute centers; cool climate cited for energy efficiency.

name: 暸疆绿色算力科技产业园（乌鲁木齐融合算力中心）(Urumqi Converged Computing Center)
developer: Xinjiang Zhongke Leinao Smart Computing Technology (新疆中科类脑智算科技)
notes: Urumqi's first smart-computing center project; phase 1 = 500P, expected live by end-2024/2025; includes AI incubation and green-computing platform per Huyangnet (Dec 2024).

name: 国信中健西域智算中心 (Guoxin Zhongjian Xiyu Smart Computing Center, Khorgos)
notes: Announced Nov 2024: 10,000P compute planned in Khorgos (Yili prefecture) with domestic core chips; self-media announcements only so far.

name: 保山绿电+智算项目 (Baoshan Green-Power + Smart-Computing program)
notes: Yunnan coordinating '绿电+智算' projects in Baoshan (and Yuxi) alongside the Kunming Wanxichong park; program-level planning, no named facility yet.

name: 昆明万溪冲智算产业园 (Kunming Wanxichong Smart Computing Industrial Park, Chenggong)
developer: Yunnan Digital Economy Development Zone (China Unicom, China Mobile, Huawei, Inspur, Yuntou tenants)
notes: Yunnan's first approved smart-computing industrial cluster (provincial data bureau, Nov 2024); 8 large data centers, 193k sqm built, 21k racks, ~3,034P compute (Sep 2025).

name: 云上云·云南省信息化中心项目 (Yunnan Provincial Informatization Center)
notes: Total investment 2.244B RMB; long-term planned compute 8,885P; to become a southwestern hub for government & BeiDou applications.

name: 中国移动(云南)数据中心 (China Mobile Yunnan Data Center)
notes: 622P compute built + 400P under construction; tenant in Wanxichong park (per 2025 Chenggong digital-economy reporting).

name: 中国联通两亚国际智算中心 (China Unicom Liangya International Smart Computing Center)
notes: Built/completed per 2025 reporting; part of Kunming's hub serving South/Southeast Asia compute demand.

name: 昆明人工智能计算中心 (Kunming AI Computing Center)
developer: Kunming municipal / Yunnan digital economy zone
notes: Filled Yunnan's gap for a large public AI-compute center; cited alongside Wanxichong park approval (Nov 2024).
